L00.text: One channel. Three people. One app, beside the chat.

L01.text: An app is a small script that buzz runs for a channel, and draws right beside the conversation.

L02.text: Its records belong to the channel. Ada adds a card, and it lands on Lin's screen and on yours.

L03.text: Two people move the same card at the same instant. One move is saved. The other is told, and the Board merges it. Nothing is lost.

L04.text: Three apps ship with buzz: a Board, a Poll, and Approvals, where nobody signs off their own request.

L05.text: Want something else? Ask your agent, right in the channel: add a priority and a filter to the board.

L06.text: Nothing it wrote runs until you have read it: who it comes from, who asked, its hash, what changed. Down to the last line.

L07.text: Approve it, and the open app changes in place. The same card is still selected.

L08.text: To give it to the others, offer it in the channel. Ada sees who signed it, reads the same bytes, and decides for herself.

L09.text: Agents work with an app's records too, without a screen: they read its brief. Move the release notes card to Done.

L10.text: The records travel, and each client draws its own board. Here, Buzz desktop, with a plugin written from the brief.
